ATOMIC-EXTERNAL.rationale: RuntimeFoundation invokes no external prepare/commit/cancel/rollback boundary.

ATOMIC-MULTI.rationale: RuntimeFoundation has no mutator spanning multiple authoritative containers.

ATOMIC-RECONCILE.rationale: RuntimeFoundation has no fallible external rollback or reconciliation state.

LIFE-ALLOWED.rationale: RuntimeFoundation exposes value helpers and no lifecycle state machine.

LIFE-FORBIDDEN.rationale: RuntimeFoundation exposes value helpers and no lifecycle state machine.

LIFE-RETRY-CLEANUP.rationale: RuntimeFoundation has no external cleanup protocol.

LIFE-SHUTDOWN.rationale: RuntimeFoundation owns no resource, registration, thread, or service requiring shutdown.

PERSIST-CANDIDATE.rationale: RuntimeFoundation exposes no restore operation or off-state restore candidate.

PERSIST-CONTINUITY.rationale: RuntimeFoundation is a value-contract module and owns no persistent/transient state boundary.

PERSIST-FAILURE.rationale: RuntimeFoundation exposes no restore operation or live persistent state to preserve.

PERSIST-SNAPSHOT.rationale: RuntimeFoundation owns no persistent module state or snapshot format.

STATE-INDEXES.rationale: RuntimeFoundation owns no index, cache, or secondary container.

STATE-PRIMARY.rationale: RuntimeFoundation owns no long-lived primary state; its mutation helpers operate only on caller-owned scalar counters.

TEST-CALLBACK-FAILURE.rationale: RuntimeFoundation invokes no callback, provider, sink, or backend.

TEST-STALE.rationale: RuntimeFoundation monotonic identities are never removed or reused, so no stale-generation identity can be presented back to this module.

API-CLASSIFIED.rationale: All 19 final public callables have explicit query/mutator/factory/value roles; final IDs are assigned after merge.

API-FAILURE.rationale: Overflow, revision exhaustion, invalid checkpoint and allocation failure preserve pre-state.

API-INVALID.rationale: Invalid options, dates, phase enums, checkpoint scale/remainder/configuration are rejected.

API-OVERLOADS.rationale: No public overload family has competing semantic contracts. No distinct applicable overload family exists; the reviewed contract explicitly establishes the absence/applicability boundary.

API-PRECONDITIONS.rationale: Negative deltas/skips, invalid scale/calendar/phase/checkpoint inputs are explicit regressions.

API-SUCCESS.rationale: Advance, Skip, scale and lifecycle success effects and event order are covered.

ARCH-DIRECT-DEPS.rationale: Time links only Foundation and RuntimeFoundation.

ARCH-PORTS.rationale: No peer-major direct dependency or external backend port.

ARCH-RESPONSIBILITY.rationale: Generated architecture ownership assigns clock responsibility to Time.

ARCH-SINGLE-OWNER.rationale: Authoritative game time has one Runtime owner.

ATOMIC-MULTI.rationale: Compound clock/snapshot/remainder/event state publishes as one candidate commit.

ATOMIC-RECONCILE.rationale: No irreversible external success requiring reconciliation.

ATOMIC-SINGLE.rationale: Every public mutation is preflighted/candidate-built before commit.

LIFE-ALLOWED.rationale: Pause/Resume and advancing while paused follow defined state semantics.

LIFE-FORBIDDEN.rationale: Invalid state/input mutations are rejected without publication; no hidden lifecycle path exists.

LIFE-SHUTDOWN.rationale: Time owns no shutdown-managed external resource.

PERSIST-CANDIDATE.rationale: Restore builds the complete candidate before one no-fail commit.

PERSIST-CONTINUITY.rationale: Restored continuation matches uninterrupted control with fractional remainder.

PERSIST-FAILURE.rationale: Validation and injected allocation failure preserve exact live snapshot/checkpoint/events.

PERSIST-SNAPSHOT.rationale: TimeCheckpoint captures all future-determinism state plus immutable compatibility identity.

PERSIST-VALIDATE.rationale: Restore validates compatibility, normalized scale, time and remainder bounds before candidate build.

STATE-COUNTERS.rationale: Revision and game-time arithmetic have overflow/exhaustion regressions.

STATE-INDEXES.rationale: No secondary lookup index/cache with independent mutation exists.

STATE-NO-FALSE-PUBLISH.rationale: Candidate state and event staging complete before live commit.

STATE-NOOP.rationale: Advance(0), duplicate Pause/Resume and repeated semantic no-ops have defined revision/event behavior.

STATE-PRIMARY.rationale: now/scale/pause/remainder/revision are explicitly identified as authoritative.

TEST-BOUNDARY.rationale: INT64/UINT64, calendar, scale denominator, remainder and crossed-boundary cases covered.

TEST-DUPLICATE.rationale: Duplicate Pause/Resume and duplicate phase boundary validation covered.

TEST-EMPTY.rationale: Default options, empty phase-boundary input and empty transient events have defined behavior.

TEST-REGRESSION.rationale: G3-TIME-001 checkpoint continuity plus Block A invalid checkpoint hardening remain covered.

TEST-STALE.rationale: Time exposes no reusable handle/generation identity; scanner stale candidates are false positives.

TEST-WRONG-LIFECYCLE.rationale: Paused Advance and duplicate pause/resume semantics are explicit regressions.
